headline: Ghanaian Oil Marketers Cut Petrol Prices Amid Intensifying Competition
summary: GOIL has reduced its petrol price to GH¢14.99 per litre, while Star Oil lowered its price to GH¢13.95 per litre amid intensifying competition among oil marketing companies.
why: Retail fuel price competition affects profit margins for downstream petroleum distributors and influences domestic transportation and consumer price inflation.
